attributes.action: Ban MPs from Standing in By-Elections They Trigger Themselves
attributes.additional_details: Members of Parliament are elected to serve their constituents for the duration of a Parliament. If an MP chooses to resign their seat, the resulting by-election should allow voters to choose new representation. Preventing the former MP from immediately standing again would promote fairness, reduce unnecessary election costs and strengthen public confidence in the democratic process.
attributes.background: Change the law so that any Member of Parliament who voluntarily resigns their seat and triggers a by-election is disqualified from standing as a candidate in that by-election.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Prevent MPs who resign their seat from standing for re-election for 12 months" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776390
